note: Unique Field Ajax has no admin settings page (configure=null) and no permission. Its entire state is third-party settings under the 'unique_field_ajax' namespace on a field.field.* config entity (or node.type.* for titles): keys unique, per_lang, case_sensitive, use_ajax, no_enforce, message, message_warning. The settings fieldset only appears for single-cardinality fields of types string, string_long, list_string, text, email, entity_reference, path, uri, link, integer, decimal, color_field_type. Enforcement attaches #element_validate unique_field_ajax_validate_unique (and an AJAX process on event finishedinput when use_ajax). It invites hook_query_unique_field_ajax_alter() and hook_unique_field_ajax_unique_results_alter(). Medium cases read back which live Article field is marked unique; hard cases set the unique (and case_sensitive) third-party settings on a real field, verified against live config.

evals.prompt: Using the unique_field_ajax module on Drupal 11, how do I make a single text field on my Article content type reject duplicate values? There's no settings page - where do I turn it on?
evals.expected_output: There is no admin settings page. Edit the field (Manage fields > the field's settings form), open the 'Unique field settings' fieldset, tick 'Unique' and save. It is stored as a third-party setting unique_field_ajax.unique on the field's config entity (field.field.node.article.<field>).

evals.prompt: What options does unique_field_ajax offer when you mark a field unique, i.e. the third-party setting keys it stores?
evals.expected_output: unique, per_lang (per language), case_sensitive (LIKE BINARY exact case), use_ajax (live AJAX check on event finishedinput), no_enforce (warn but still save), message (custom error) and message_warning (custom warning). Messages support %link and %label tokens.

evals.prompt: Which hooks does unique_field_ajax provide so another module can change how uniqueness is checked?
evals.expected_output: hook_query_unique_field_ajax_alter(AlterableInterface $query) to alter the duplicate-check entity query (it also carries the 'unique_field_ajax' tag and metadata), and hook_unique_field_ajax_unique_results_alter(array &$result, array $metadata) to adjust the matched entity ids before pass/fail is decided.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a field configured with unique_field_ajax to require unique values. Inspect the live field configuration and give the machine name of that field.

The Article content type on this site has two text fields, field_ufa_on and field_ufa_off. Exactly one is configured with unique_field_ajax to enforce uniqueness. Inspect the live configuration and state which field enforces uniqueness.
evals.expected_output: field_ufa_on enforces uniqueness: its field config has third_party_settings.unique_field_ajax.unique = 1, whereas field_ufa_off has no unique_field_ajax setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a single-value text field field_ufa_task. Using the unique_field_ajax module, configure that field so it requires unique values, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.article.field_ufa_task gains third_party_settings.unique_field_ajax.unique = 1 (via the field's 'Unique field settings' fieldset or setThirdPartySetting).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a single-value text field field_ufa_case. Using unique_field_ajax, make this field enforce uniqueness AND make the match case-sensitive (so 'Acme' and 'acme' are considered different). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.article.field_ufa_case gains third_party_settings.unique_field_ajax.unique = 1 and unique_field_ajax.case_sensitive = 1 (tick both Unique and Case Sensitive, or set both third-party settings).
